scope: conditional pre-layout schematic review for qualified USB-powered state only

findings.claim: Pre-layout electrical mapping review passes only for the declared known 5V/1.5A USB source and selected NTC-required charger / USB-state regulator. This is not battery-mode, external-pack, thermal, firmware-behavior or physical-hardware qualification.

Retained base MCU, reset/boot, native USB GPIO19/20, independent CC 5.1k terminations, USBLC6 channel/GND/VBUS mapping and 22Ohm series links match the previously inspected primary pin/reference documents. Selected audio buses use distinct GPIO4/5/6 and GPIO7/15/16; LED uses GPIO17; GPIO8/9 remain shared I2C.

BQ24074 pads 1 TS,2/3 BAT,4 CE low,5 EN2 high,6 EN1 low,8 VSS,10/11 SYS OUT,12 ILIM,13 IN,16 ISET,17 EP ground match TI pin functions. TMR/ITERM float for defaults. Separate real J2 NTC sense/return connector reaches TS/GND; old fixed-TS-bypass block is not selected.

4.7k ISET yields about189.4mA nominal /209.7mA worst high; 1.2k ILIM low corner about1237.6mA leaves only17.6mA over declared1000mA SYS +210mA charge +10mA own maximum. This arithmetic relies on the stated operating assumptions, source voltage at the board, thermal layout and load envelopes; no measured headroom or simultaneous transient guarantee.

Protected pack, safe cell charge specification, correct keyed harness and thermally coupled qualified 10k NTC remain external requirements. Declared SEMITEC103AT-2 tolerance corners can allow hot trip approximately46.1–55.9C and cold trip−1.8–2.9C, so this circuit does not establish a common0–45C pack charging requirement. No battery/supplement/fallback mode approval and no charger block promotion.

TPS63001 pads 4/2 connect2.2uH inductor; VIN5,VINA8,EN6 reach SYS; PS7 is low; PGND3,GND9,EP11 ground; fixed-output FB10 returns VOUT1. Input/output bypass follows the inspected TI reference topology.

Selected input range4.2–4.5V describes USB-powered charger SYS regulation only. 650mA continuous,800mA peak,85% efficiency and declared thermal model are estimates. Effective ceramic capacitance with DC bias, inductor/transient/thermal layout and battery-low behavior remain unqualified.

ICS-43434 pin1 WS,2 LR grounded for left channel,3 GND,4 SCK,5 VDD,6 SD match manufacturer application;100nF bypass and100k SD pulldown present. 48kHz,64 clocks per stereo frame and24-bit data in32-bit slots match the intended interface.

MAX98357A TQFN DIN1,GAIN2 ground(12dB),GND3/11/15/EP17,SD_MODE4 VDD(left always on),VDD7/8,OUTP9/OUTN10,LRCLK14,BCLK16 and NC5/6/12/13 match manufacturer pin table. Differential speaker connector returns neither output to ground;100nF+10uF bypass present.

Amplifier380/500mA declared loads require qualified8Ohm inductive speaker (>10uH), bounded gain/volume and transient measurement. Speaker is an external connector contract. Microphone bottom acoustic opening, speaker harness, sequencing/back-power injection and audio performance remain physical/hardware work.

Worldsemi physical DIN is pad4,VDD1,GND3,DOUT2 unused. TI AHCT OE1 low,A2 from3.3V MCU,Y4 to DIN,VCC5 at5V,GND3 provides valid TTL input threshold and5V output. Both bypass capacitors and corrected TI title citation agree with actual sources.

39/63mA are author-supplied operating budgets, not measured waveforms; full-brightness/transient and power-sequence validation remain required. Reset/latch duration must exceed the selected LED revision requirement.

SSD1306 board is an external0x3C/3.3V/50mA module contract, not a selected verified bare OLED IC. Display connector1GND2VDD3SCL4SDA differs from carrier header3SDA4SCL intentionally; harness must match. Parallel10k pullups produce5k. Total capacitance/rise time and actual module power/address remain unverified.
